hypothesis: With exactly the same Mobile Actions semantic supervision, the 494,032,768-parameter Qwen2.5 instruction baseline may outperform BarunAction-35M candidate-v2 on strict Action IR development exact match; a second independent architecture tests whether the existing SmolLM2 comparison is family-specific.
decision: Run this single recipe once. Preserve its final-checkpoint predictions regardless of outcome. Use it only as a second matched public-development architecture comparison; it cannot select or modify BarunAction training or the active rescue winner.

model.parameter_count_policy: Load the exact revision and sum unique parameter storage views, counting tied input/output embeddings once; abort unless the measured count is exactly 494,032,768.

data.official_eval_firewall: The runner accepts no source-dataset or official-eval path. Only the frozen train manifest, dev manifest, and audit are staged. The audit must prove all 961 official rows remained opaque, unparsed, unmaterialized, un-tokenized, and excluded from overlap analysis.

information_budget.train_example_ids: identical to BarunAction candidate-v2 uniform arm
information_budget.semantic_system_content: byte-identical ACTION_IR_V1, NOW, ordered TOOLS schemas, descriptions, types, and required flags from each frozen manifest prompt
information_budget.targets: byte-identical canonical Action IR v1 strings
information_budget.allowed_model_specific_difference: Only tokenizer-native chat role/control tokens and tokenization may differ; no vendor tool schema or extra instruction is added.

rendering.method: Strictly remove the frozen Barun role wrapper, pass the unchanged semantic system and user strings to tokenizer.apply_chat_template(add_generation_prompt=true), and render the unchanged target as the assistant message for SFT.

evaluation.population: the frozen 756-row grouped Mobile Actions development manifest only

paired_reference.comparison: Recompute both aggregates from sample-level evidence, require exactly the same 756 unique IDs, and report candidate-only wins, baseline-only wins, and ties.

trial_budget.next_change_if_result_is_weak: Record the negative result. Any second baseline recipe must be separately preregistered and cannot replace this evidence.

compute.lifecycle: Use one newly created barun-* instance through infra/jarvis/safe_run.py; stage only train/dev/audit inputs; download essential evidence; pause and verify only its exact recorded ID.

retry_policy.allowed: One infrastructure-only retry is allowed only for an environment, import, transfer, or CUDA failure before any development prediction or score exists.
retry_policy.required_evidence: Record the failed exact machine ID, phase, logs, whether model/data scoring occurred, and the parent-attempt chain; pause-verify that machine before any retry.

claim_limit: This one-seed, one-recipe public-development comparison is not a universal beats-larger-models result. It has no official Mobile Actions test score, no sealed safety suite, no matched multi-seed uncertainty interval, and less dev-tuning budget than BarunAction candidate-v2. It is useful as a second matched-adaptation architecture comparison only.
